map.糖粉法检测，即每百只蜂寄生螨数；达阈值需防治。: Sugar-dust method: mites per 100 bees; treat when threshold reached.
map.蜂螨寄生率(%) = 检出螨数 ÷ 样本蜂数 × 100: Varroa rate (%) = detected mites / sample bees x 100
map.计算蜂群狄斯瓦螨（Varroa）自然寄生率，结合防治阈值判读危害等级并给出处置建: Compute a colony's natural Varroa destructor parasitism rate, interpret hazard level by treatment threshold, and give advice. Supports sugar-dust, alcohol-wash, and natural-drop data entry.
map.寄生率(%) = 检出螨数 ÷ 样本蜂数 × 100，即\"每百蜂螨数\": Rate (%) = detected mites / sample bees x 100, i.e. "mites per 100 bees"
map.防治阈值随季节调整：秋季越冬前最为关键，阈值较低；不同地区阈值略有差异: Treatment threshold varies by season: pre-winter autumn is most critical with lower threshold; regions differ slightly
map.自然脱落法建议结合蜂群子脾面积换算，结果偏低时勿轻易判定安全: Natural-drop method: convert by brood comb area; when low, do not easily judge safe
map.按糖粉摇落法或酒精冲洗法采集样本工蜂，统计检出螨数并计算寄生率。: Collect sample workers by sugar-dust shaking or alcohol rinse, count detected mites and compute rate.
map.对比不同蜂群、不同时期的寄生率，判断是否达到需要治螨的阈值。: Compare rates across colonies and times to judge if treatment threshold reached.
map.取 300 只工蜂样本，冲洗检出蜂螨 9 只，寄生率 = 9 ÷ 300 × 1: 300 worker sample, rinse detects 9 mites, rate = 9/300 x 100% = 3.0%, above the 2%-3% reference line; suggest treatment by colony strength and season.
map.常用 200~300 只工蜂，样本越大估算越稳定。建议多点取样（子脾边角与外勤蜂: Common 200-300 workers; larger sample steadier. Multi-point sampling (brood-frame edges, foragers), avoid one location for whole colony.
map.成年蜂寄生率一般超过 2%~3%，或巢房检出率明显上升时即需安排防治；还需结合群: Adult-bee rate generally >2%-3%, or comb detection rising, needs treatment; also combine colony strength, flow period, capping; avoid medicating in flow to contaminate honey.
map.不同方法（糖粉、酒精、CO₂ 麻醉）测得的效率不同，应固定同一方法做纵向对比；检: Methods (sugar-dust, alcohol, CO₂ anesthesia) differ in efficiency; fix one method for longitudinal comparison; return bees promptly, avoid cold-period operation to prevent loss.
map.狄斯瓦螨是危害蜜蜂最严重的外寄生虫。本工具依据样本蜂数与检出螨数计算寄生率，结合: Varroa destructor is the most serious external parasite of bees. This tool computes rate from sample bees and detected mites, interprets hazard by seasonal threshold, guiding timely treatment to protect colony health.
